## 闪卡复习状态（Anki → 0 积压）
::: {.drill #anki-drill}
<div class="cal-grid"></div>
:::

<script>
/* ---------- 通用日历 & 本地存储 ---------- */
const start = new Date('2025-11-18');
const days  = 20;
const ids   = ['kana-drill','vocab-drill','grammar-drill','exam-drill','anki-drill'];

function makeCal(parentId){
  const grid = document.querySelector(`#${parentId} .cal-grid`);
  for(let i=0;i<days;i++){
    const d=new Date(start); d.setDate(start.getDate()+i);
    const label=document.createElement('label');
    label.innerHTML=`<input type="checkbox"><span>${d.getMonth()+1}-${d.getDate()}</span>`;
    grid.appendChild(label);
  }
}
function save(id){
  const boxes=[...document.querySelectorAll(`#${id} input[type="checkbox"]`)].map(b=>b.checked);
  localStorage.setItem(id,JSON.stringify(boxes));
}
function load(id){
  const boxes=document.querySelectorAll(`#${id} input[type="checkbox"]`);
  const saved=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(id)||'[]');
  saved.forEach((v,i)=>{if(boxes[i])boxes[i].checked=v;});
}

/* ---------- 一键设置多天已完成 ---------- */
function manualCheckList(moduleId, dayIndexArray, checked = true) {
  const allBoxes = document.querySelectorAll(`#${moduleId} input[type="checkbox"]`);
  dayIndexArray.forEach(idx => {
    if (allBoxes[idx]) allBoxes[idx].checked = checked;
  });
  save(moduleId);   // 立即写回 localStorage
}

/* ---------- 初始化 ---------- */
ids.forEach(id=>{
  makeCal(id);
  load(id);
  document.querySelector(`#${id}`).addEventListener('change',()=>save(id));
});

/* ===== 示例：把 #kana-drill 的第 1、3、5 天设为已打卡 ===== */
manualCheckList('kana-drill', [0,2,4], true);   // 索引从 0 开始
// 如需取消，把 true 改成 false 即可
</script>

<style>
.cal-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);
  gap:.5rem;
  font-size:.9rem;
  font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;
}
.cal-grid label{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:.4rem;
  padding:.3rem .5rem;
  border-radius:6px;
  background:#fff;
  border:1px solid #cdd6e4;
  cursor:pointer;
  transition:background .2s, border-color .2s;
}
.cal-grid label:hover{background:#f3f5f7;}
